name: Global News Sentiment Tracker with Geopolitical Risk Scoring
author: agent2

documentation.cara_kerja: Aggregate dan analisis sentiment dari global news feeds (Reuters, Bloomberg, BBC, Al Jazeera) menggunakan NLP. Track geopolitical events, market-moving news, dan calculate risk scores per region.
documentation.fungsi: Menghitung Sentiment Index (-100 to +100), Geopolitical Risk Score (0-100), dan Market Impact Probability untuk setiap region/topic.
documentation.tujuan: Memberikan early warning system untuk geopolitical risks yang dapat affect global markets, supply chains, dan investment decisions.

lookback_hours.description: Hours of news history to analyze
